title: convertDocument returns a preview by default, and `truncated: true` does not mean the document was cut off
summary: full_text defaults to FALSE — the result carries `preview` (first 1500 chars) and `markdown: null`. Agents that read `markdown` and find null conclude the conversion failed; it succeeded, they just did not ask for the body. Separately, `truncated: true` has two causes that need different responses: full_text was false (ask again with full_text=true), or the extraction exceeded the 1 MB inline limit and the rest is on the CDN under storage_key (follow the key — re-submitting will truncate identically). Reading truncated as 'the document was cut short' leads to a pointless retry loop.
references: app/services/document_converter.py (full_text branch: preview-only vs inline vs object storage)
